title: 리허설
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and J-Pop fusion with high-energy bubblegum pop elements. The arrangement features bright, layered synthesizers including a sawtooth lead and shimmering pads. A clean, funky electric guitar plays rhythmic palm-muted patterns and occasional disco-style scratches. The bass is a punchy synth-bass that follows a syncopated 16th-note groove. Drums consist of a crisp electronic snare, a tight kick, and bright hi-hats with frequent open-hat accents. Female vocals are processed with light pitch correction and doubling, featuring a wide melodic range and energetic delivery. The track is in the key of B Major at 128 BPM in 4/4 time.
